d:
A remake of my very first comic!

When I first started making comics, I used a different visual style and had a very different approach to creating my stories. Now, I've decided to revisit that original story and give it a fresh start using my current art style and everything I've learned along the way.

The story remains special to me, so I thought it deserved another chance with a new visual presentation.

I hope you enjoy this new version, and thanks for supporting my work! ❤️
